comment: What a person reads about which of the method's questions helped them, and the numbers that decide when a comparison is shown. `minimum` is the fewest decisions a side of any comparison needs before a share or a before-and-after is stated; below it the screen says `not_enough`. `recent` is how many of the person's latest decisions are compared with the ones before them. Sentences fill {named} parts from counted rows; no number is typed into them.
heading: What has helped you
empty: Nothing to show yet. Once your AI has worked through a few decisions with Trillion, the questions that changed your answer and how those decisions turned out appear here.
not_enough: not enough results yet to compare

goal.heading: Decisions that hit their goal
goal.counted: {met} of {known} decisions with a result hit their goal
goal.share: {share}% of decisions with a result hit their goal ({met} of {known})
goal.waiting: {waiting} still waiting to hear how they went

time.heading: Time from decision to done
time.done: Typical time from deciding to a checked result: {time} (over {count} decisions)
time.deciding: Typical time to decide: {now} for your latest {recent}, {before} for the {earlier} before
time.goal_change: Hit their goal: {now} of your latest {recent} with a result, {before} of the {earlier} before

questions.heading: Most useful questions for you
questions.changed: Changed your answer in {changed} of {asked} decisions
questions.compare: When it changed your answer, {changed_met} of {changed_known} hit their goal; when it did not, {unchanged_met} of {unchanged_known}
